item.title: Hello Zigfall
item.description:
Hello Zigfall

This is the first entry in this year’s devlog created with Zine!

10 days left to start JS13k Game Jam, the prototype version of the game we will be writing in Zig is in development. I hope the JS13k version enters into top 100, meanwhile this week we will start with Windows SDK and create a window and render basic textures etc..
